title: Zero Sum SVD: Balancing Loss Sensitivity for Low Rank LLM Compression
abstract: arXiv:2602.02848v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Advances in large language models have driven strong performance across many tasks, but their memory and compute costs still hinder deployment. SVD-based compression reduces storage and can speed up inference via low-rank factors, yet performance depends on how rank is allocated under a global compression ratio. Prior methods often use homogeneous ranks for similarly sized matrices, despite large differences in loss sensitivity, or rely on expensive iterative pre-truncation optimization to determine per matrix ranks. We propose Zero Sum SVD (ZS-SVD), a post-training method that performs global singular component selection using activation whitening and first-order calibration loss estimates in whitened coordinates. ZS-SVD prunes components across the whole model with a zero sum rule that keeps the cumulative predicted loss change near zero, automatically yielding heterogeneous ranks without solving a rank allocation optimization. translated_title: 零和SVD：面向大语言模型低秩压缩的损失敏感度平衡方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.02848v2 公告类型：replace 摘要：大语言模型的进展在许多任务中带来了强大的性能，但其内存和计算成本仍然阻碍了部署。基于SVD的压缩能够减少存储，并可通过低秩因子加速推理，但其性能取决于在全局压缩比下如何分配秩。先前的方法通常对大小相似的矩阵使用同质的秩分配，尽管它们在损失敏感度上差异很大，或者依赖昂贵的迭代预截断优化来确定每个矩阵的秩。我们提出零和SVD（ZS-SVD），这是一种后训练方法，它利用激活白化以及白化坐标下的一阶校准损失估计来执行全局奇异分量选择。ZS-SVD以零和规则在整个模型范围内剪枝奇异分量，使累积预测损失变化保持接近于零，从而在无需求解秩分配优化问题的情况下自动产生异构秩。
tldr: 提出零和SVD（ZS-SVD）后训练压缩方法，利用激活白化、一阶校准损失估计和零和剪枝规则，在无需求解秩分配优化的情况下自动为各矩阵分配异构秩，实现兼顾性能与效率的大语言模型低秩压缩。
en_tdlr: ZS-SVD is a post-training SVD compression method that performs global singular component selection with activation whitening and first-order calibration loss estimates, using a zero-sum pruning rule to automatically yield heterogeneous ranks without solving a rank allocation optimization.
